name: Vulk TAU-6-23 "Blastmill" rotary blaster cannon
description: A Vulk TAU-6-23 "Blastmill" rotary blaster cannon was a blaster cannon used by the Gigoran mercenary Moroff. They were among the weapons purchased by Masse Goskey and Ephant Mon for sale at Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart.
